pathAssistantSteps.info:
Accepted - SOF signed and Order created.

  • Upload signed SOF via Accept Quote action
  • System auto-creates Draft Order from this Quote
  • Opportunity MRC, NRC, and Amount are updated automatically

Approved - ready to present to customer.

  • Quote has passed internal review
  • Send to customer via email or portal
  • Log the send date and customer contact

Draft - build the commercial proposal.

  • Add products via Add Product action
  • Set expiry date and target site
  • Verify MRC, NRC, and contract term with the opportunity owner

In Review - pending internal approval.

  • Revenue Ops reviewing commercial terms
  • VP Sales sign-off required if Deal Review triggered
  • Do not send to customer until Approved

Presented - quote delivered to customer.

  • Follow up within 48 hours
  • Log any customer questions or objections
  • Negotiate and revise via Revise Quote if needed

Rejected - quote declined by customer or internal.

  • Log the rejection reason in the Opportunity notes
  • Revise and resubmit or close the Opportunity as Lost
